strategy_roster.name: MACross
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(8)/SMA(20) crossover and inverse exit are translated exactly. The 20-pip stop and target, minimum-equity guard, money management, and finished-candle scheduling are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Lorenzo SuperScalp
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14), Bollinger(20,2), and MACD(12,26,9) retain the documented long thresholds and crossover. The 15-bar minimum re-entry delay, short-side filters, and no-stop rule are not all representable in a stateless long-only entry.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Hull Trend
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(9) and its SMA(9) are an explicit smooth-HMA proxy because the source supplies no Hull length; their bullish/bearish crosses translate the trend change. The exact Hull calculation, timeframe, and any unspecified protection are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Slope Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar volume z-score above the documented 2.0 multiplier with positive slope retains the breakout rule; the opposite reversion exits. The documented 2% stop is encoded, while the proprietary slope indicator and 5-minute timeframe are approximated.

strategy_roster.name: Doji Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open - 0.001 * close and close < open + 0.001 * close and roc(close,3) < 0
strategy_roster.exit_long: close > open + 0.001 * close or close < open - 0.001 * close
strategy_roster.notes: A close within a 0.1% band of open after a three-bar decline is an explicit doji proxy, and a break beyond the band is the doji-extreme exit. The documented 1% stop is retained; exact candle classification and both-direction reversal are approximated.

strategy_roster.name: LBS
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish close above the previous candle high is the market proxy for the two-sided stop breakout. Trading-hour gates, freeze buffer, pending-order cancellation, 50-pip stop, trailing, and pip targets are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: AIS1 EURUSD Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar high break with EMA(20) trend agreement approximates the previous-daily-range continuation entry. Daily/4-hour timeframe mapping, stop/take factors, trailing range, risk sizing, and cooldown are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Momentum Candle Sign
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(open,12) versus ROC(close,12) preserves the documented open/close momentum crossover and opposite exit. The default 12-hour timeframe is not modeled, and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: EA Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(5)<80 with a falling three-bar RSI proxy represents the stochastic remaining below the upper level; RSI>50 is the recovery exit. Stochastic K/D smoothing, exact compared-bar state, pip stops/targets, and trailing are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Long Position DAX 2 Hours Dow Jones 1 Hour
strategy_roster.notes: The documented RSI(14) cross above oversold 35, target 55, and stop 30 are translated directly. The strategy is long-only and the source explicitly has no percentage stop; its multi-timeframe labels do not add DSL conditions.
